parsedVerdict.reasoning: StockReservationService is a domain service. Its job is a business rule that spans aggregates: stock reservation is all-or-nothing. It checks every consolidated line with product.assertCanReserve before any product.reserve call. It works only with domain concepts (OrderLine, Product), uses a domain error (NotFoundError), and depends on ProductRepository, a domain-owned interface (port), not a concrete persistence technology. It has no transport, framework, SQL, ORM or I/O logic. Calling the repository port to load and save products is a borderline point: some would put that in the application layer. Still, using a port declared in the domain is accepted practice for domain services and adds no infrastructure concern. No ADR prose was given that says otherwise. All responsibilities fit the domain layer.
